resources.string: %1$s has no shared folder “%2$s”. Check its name in the NAS’s interface.
The NAS does not share %s over NFS. On a Synology, the mount path starts with /volume1/.
%1$s answers, but “%2$s” is not in it. Check its name, capitals included.
“%1$s” answers, but “%2$s” is not in it. Check its name, capitals included.
The NAS refuses this player. Allow %1$s on %2$s, read-only, and on a Synology non-privileged ports.
The NAS refuses this player. Allow this player’s address on %s, read-only, and on a Synology non-privileged ports.
The NAS does not let root read %s. Choose “NFS account” and enter an account that can.
The account “%1$s” cannot read “%2$s”. Give it read access on the NAS, or use another account.
This NAS does not accept guests: enter an account.
